title: Seven values and one outlier
caption: Median 5, quartiles 4 and 9, so IQR = 5 and the fences are 4 − 7.5 and 9 + 7.5 = 16.5: the value 30 lies beyond the upper fence and is drawn as an outlier.
alt: A box plot of 2, 4, 4, 5, 7, 9, 30: box from 4 to 9 with median 5, whisker to 2 and 9, and the value 30 plotted separately as an outlier.
description: The median is the middle value, 5; the quartiles are 4 and 9, so the box spans 4 to 9 (IQR 5).
The upper fence is 9 + 1.5 × 5 = 16.5; the lower fence is −3.5.
30 is beyond 16.5, so it is an outlier and the whisker stops at 9.
